6.Text: ...I'll slay him where he stands. And not for the first.

7.Text: {#Emph}Not for the first{#Prev}, truly? Then you must know the meaninglessness of the act! Look at me, Daughter. I could do nothing against him on my own. Even though I, too, have fought him before. {#Emph}Slain {#Prev}him before!

8.Text: I'm sorry, Father. But I shall not be deterred, even by you. Now let me free you from these bonds!

9.Text: {#Emph}No! {#Prev}No, that would bring greater ruin, nothing more. Now, get out of this place. Though let me lend to you what strength I still possess.

1.Text: What are you doing here again? I told you, you {#Emph}cannot {#Prev}be here!

2.Text: And I told {#Emph}you {#Prev}I'd be back for you. Though my priority is Chronos. You vanquished him before. Can you reveal to me any weaknesses? Anything at all?

3.Text: {#Emph}I {#Prev}vanquished him with the aid of {#Emph}five other gods! {#Prev}What hope have you, alone? He has no weakness, save his arrogance. And it appears you have that weakness, too.

4.Text: Then it seems we are equally matched. Father, how long have you been this way? Is there aught I can do?

5.Text: You think I've any sense of time in such a place? And I've said already what you can do: {#Emph}Risk not your everything. {#Prev}Go now, and be unseen.

1.Text: I know not how you withstood the Titan, if truly you confronted him. Quickly now, tell me but this: Have you been... are you well?

2.Text: Am I... well? All my life I've been preparing for this moment, to bring the usurper of the House of Hades to justice. So, I'll have to get back to you, depending on how it goes.

3.Text: ...I'm sorry... I'm sorry. Get back to me if you must. I'd grant your vengeance if I could. But this is all that I can do for now.

1.Text: These blessings are mere trifles, but if they have been effective, so be it.
Zagreus sends his regards. The Underworld has kept him busy recently.
What my father did to Tartarus is a disgrace we shall correct in time...
My father may be different now, but if any old trace of him remains, destroy it.
Let us ensure that nothing like what we have withstood shall ever again transpire.
I shall always have wrath to spare for any remnants of my father's former self.
I would bear witness to your victories if I could, though shall be there in spirit.
Your work has drawn you to the surface more and more, so it is good to see you here.
Cerberus was practically unable to sit still as you approached.
Your brother sends you his regards. He must be somewhere near the surface now.
Cerberus was quite insistent that you would soon arrive, and sure enough.
Such suffocating darkness here... almost akin to how it used to be.
My father's remnant forces all seem very riled up... as long as this is your doing.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Oh, Melinoë, you're back! We thought we might find you here... well, Hades did. I never would have guessed.

2.Text: Your Mother and I had looked forward to seeing you again ever since you departed. How have you fared? Are matters in the Crossroads well in hand?

3.Text: Everything is more or less all right, Father. It's good to see you in this chamber in far better spirits than before, though... why return to such a place? I'd have thought you'd rather be just about anywhere else.

4.Text: The House is partially in order but the rest of Tartarus yet bears the mark of my father's extravagant tastes. Whatever harm he caused our family, undoing his decor shall take longer still!

5.Text: Grandfather shall do his part. It also means I get to say hello.

6.Text: Well I shall do my small part then, in the retracing of your steps. Provided I may be of service still. Here.

1.Text: Soot from the House...
Indeed. May it be of use.
How have the two of you been doing in all this? It must be quite a stressful time, having to get the House and Underworld back in order.

2.Text: Oh, it is somewhat less stressful than being imprisoned, fearing the worst for my family and dog, and watching the Underworld become unrecognizable.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: It's very different in my case. In this life... one moment I was a new mother, and now I'm not! For what it's worth, you were always an adorable baby, Melinoë.

4.Text: You could always try and have another child, I suppose? We have nowhere near the numbers on Olympus, besides.

5.Text: {#Emph}Augh! {#Prev}Let us not tempt the Fates with such talk, wherever they may be. You and your brother are more than sufficient.

1.Text: How fare the renovations to the House thus far? It was looking rather far along even before I departed.

2.Text: Appearances can be deceiving, as you must already know, Daughter. The initial work is rather quick. Addressing the details takes much, much longer.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Especially if all the details must be exactly as before.

4.Text: And why should we settle for less? Anything that we did not want changed ought to remain as we desired it.

5.Text: Sounds like a big undertaking. Can I do something to assist?

6.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
6.Text: Best leave this one to us, Melinoë. We're pleased to see you here! Your father can administer his blessings and take his mind off of everything! Isn't that right, Hades?

7.Text: {#Emph}<Grumble> {#Prev}Just make your choice and go, Daughter.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Wanted to mention, Achilles sends his greetings and well-wishes! Says he fondly recalls the practice bouts you had with Zagreus... {#Emph}erm{#Prev}, might have had. He and the other Houseservants are doing better lately.

2.Text: I'm glad to hear it, and please send him my greetings and well-wishes in return. Having known him, at least in our other past... I was concerned he'd take what happened very hard. I mean the attack on the House.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: I think he did take it hard, in his way. His responsibility is to protect the House, but Chronos was too much for him... for any of us. Perhaps gods such as we, or heroes such as Achilles, need the world to remind us to have a little humility from time to time...

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: You're of course so much like the daughter I remember from the other past we shared, or dreamed. But the small ways in which you're different from that Melinoë are fascinating. You seem... more mature. In control.

2.Text: Well... I suppose I had to grow up faster in the Crossroads than in the House, so perhaps that explains it. I also didn't have quite as much training in that life. But I'm still me, I think!

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: I always wondered to what extent we are who we are down to the core, or whether it's our surroundings and upbringing that shapes us. The truth may lie somewhere in the middle.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Hades won't speak of it in polite company, but we have quite the administrative backlog to work through. The number of mortals that perished since we lost the House, compounded by the consequences of the war... it's terrible.

2.Text: All those Shades need to be processed, judged, and placed... and in some cases located. How are you ever going to do all that?

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: We'll get through it in due time. Chip away as Daedalus might with one of his more elaborate works. And for now, there's plenty of room in Asphodel for Shades looking for a place to stay.

1.Text: Daughter... we had... meant to ask you at some point, about your arm, because... well, it is but a curiosity, and one you need not indulge, if the subject is best avoided...

2.Text: Oh, right! I'm so accustomed to it now that I never thought to mention it. I... had a bit of an accident, a long time ago. Turned out that my grasp over life and death was not as strong as I thought. It's been a good reminder ever since.

3.Text: Yet your connection to the dead we sense is very strong. Well, we each have our scars from lessons learned... most are not as noticeable or intriguing. Your mother and I figured it was more of a personal choice.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: You have my blessings as well, you know that, don't you, Melinoë? Unfortunately, I'm not supposed to offer you the more-tangible kind while we're cleaning up after Chronos.

2.Text: Surely my own blessings shall suffice? Our daughter has already faced and vanquished this Titan many times... there is no need to alter what has already been working well.

3.Text: Simply seeing you two is enough to carry me to the end. Though I'm certain Mother's blessings would have made me even stronger. Power over life and death and such...!

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: Well, when you put it {#Emph}that {#Prev}way... I suppose I take after my own mother more than I sometimes let on.

5.Text: Daughter... your mother brought life to this realm where it never should have been able to take hold, and we are richer for it.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Do you remember how you used to play with Cerberus as though he were your trusty steed? At least he's still getting plenty of activity thanks to you.

2.Text: I remember, yes! You helped me get on him and not fall down. He was very patient and gentle considering I was quite rough with him. Where I grew up in the Crossroads, I had much smaller beasts to keep me company.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: The more the better, I suppose. You were always our princess growing up, in that other past... perhaps we weren't quite as strict with you as Hecate.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: I asked your father to prioritize the renovation of this chamber, if this is to be the place where we meet up now and again. And do you know what he said?

2.Text: {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, was it along the lines of {#Emph}Yes, my Queen, I ought to honor your request at once?

3.Text: I merely said we ought to leave this chamber's updating for last... for I would not erase the memory of how it is. Though perhaps it shall remain this way for {#Emph}ages {#Prev}at the current rate.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Sometimes I wish we could spend more time together, you know? But then I recall how it was for {#Emph}me {#Prev}growing up. Just... don't forget we're here if you need anything.

2.Text: Of course I won't. How was it living with Grandmother? She seems so intense, and capable... I like her a lot.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: I'm glad. Your Grandmother Demeter and I, we had our difficulties now and then, but it's been better since I moved down here. My grand conclusion from it all is simply that children need their space... as hard as it is to let them go.

1.Text: We heard that you were on your way, Daughter. So your mother ensured we each would be here in time to greet you.

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: Way to reveal my entire plan, Hades! We just wanted to say hi, Melinoë. Since we can't exactly have you over at the House for now.

3.Text: Hello to each of you in turn. How has everyone been? Zagreus, and all the other Houseservants?

4.Text: They all are back to work; and well we ought, now that we're done exchanging pleasantries. Do rid us of my father's lingering threat, while we rid this place of his horrid styling.

1.Text: How has your relationship been with the Witch of the Crossroads, Mother? She thinks so highly of you and Father, that much I know.

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: Hecate was the best handmaiden a Queen could ask for, other than her reticence. We knew she plied her trade in shadow, but with us she was nothing if not dependable.

3.Text: You say she was your handmaiden... that's no longer going to be the case, is it?

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: I can find other handmaidens. But there is only the one Witch of the Crossroads, and from everything we gather, she needs you as much as you need her. We're counting on her more than ever, you could say.

1.Text: We've you to thank for the return of Hypnos. He would not cease apologizing for his dereliction of duty. He now is taking stock of the number of days he missed work.

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: We figured that would help to keep him occupied... seeing as we haven't been able to take in as many newcomers as we once did.

3.Text: The court has remained closed! Nevertheless, there are growing numbers of Shades awaiting their turns, and we require Hypnos to keep them orderly and informed.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: He's going to have difficulty keeping all of them at bay if there's no telling when court shall reopen, though.

5.Text: {#Emph}Augh{#Prev}, we need not bore our daughter with administrative drudgery. The point was merely that this missing son of Nyx has now been located. One fewer matter to resolve.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: That little Pom we gave you. We commissioned a very small number using only the finest gemstones, and always meant for you to have one once you were of age...

2.Text: Well, surprise! And thank you. Not only is it beautiful, but it makes me feel more connected to the two of you.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Poms are said to have that effect. One could eat just a handful of their seeds and never want to leave the Underworld again!

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: I'm glad that little Pom we gave you is coming in handy. The pomegranate didn't always grow here in the Underworld... back when I arrived, it was rather gloomier down here.

2.Text: Truly? What I've seen of the surface has felt rather gloomier than here. Though I suppose I've only seen a little war-torn bit of it. Do you ever miss being up there?

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: I miss things about it every now and then. But the Underworld has become my home, as it has your father's. And now your brother's and your own... which turns out to be a fine reason to keep looking after it!

1.Text: It's really good to see you both here. Do all the Satyrs and such leave you well alone?

2.Text: We're not the ones having to violate the principles of reality as we understand it, Daughter. It seems my father must permit his zealous followers to run free awhile longer to prevent any further {#Emph}misunderstandings {#Prev}between us.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: But to answer more directly, Melinoë, the Satyrs and such all flee from us on sight. Often with little goatlike screams!

4.Text: I know that you are not so fortunate. The least your mother and I can do is prepare you for the final confrontation that awaits.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Nyx doesn't always show it, but she's very grateful for everything you've done, you know. You're even using her own Aspect of Xinth... it's a good thing she isn't too prideful!

2.Text: I often have to remind myself that so much of the world as I know it exists thanks to her... not to mention the Unseen. She's amazing... though must be very busy.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Well, the original reason your father came here at all was to alleviate some of that burden. And to think... presiding over the entire Underworld was only {#Emph}part {#Prev}of her responsibilities. Thank you for helping her.

1.Text: Mother, aren't you expected on Olympus sometime soon? I've been traveling there recently... though, you must have a more efficient means than mine.

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: My means was with the aid of Hermes, during times when all the surface wasn't still beset with dangerous remnants of a recent war. And, no... for now, my travels are postponed. We all agreed to wait until things finally settle down.

3.Text: But that might be such a long way's off... there are times this renovation effort seems like it may take forever.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: We're goddesses and gods; we're patient, or at least, we're supposed to be. Your grandmother Demeter and I shall find other ways to stay in touch for now.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: The Skull Revaal... Nyx once offered it to me for my protection, just in case. I never would have thought it would protect me even while not in my care.

2.Text: Would you like it back at this point, Mother? Perhaps my time as Revaal's bearer is drawing to a close now that you're back.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Well, whether the Fates already predetermined this or I'm deciding it right now, no thank you. If the Argent Skull has gotten you {#Emph}this {#Prev}far, then you two make a proper team.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: You're bearing my Aspect of the Skull Revaal, and making use of our family's Jeweled Pom... I'd hoped that we could aid you, but not expected this to be the way!

2.Text: Father's blessing and the Argent Skull make a potent combination. And I'm reminded of all the times we shared... well, that we could have shared.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Even if that other past is merely what could have been, the memories are real, and I'll cherish them... alongside the memories that we've been making since.

1.Text: Gold, everywhere, {#Emph}pah! {#Prev}The light refracting from it constantly assaults my eyes. This reconstruction shall be interminable! We're nowhere {#Emph}close {#Prev}to finishing the House itself!

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: It's all right, Hades. Things were quite recently much worse, and we've weathered worse storms. Why all the urgency?

3.Text: If not for {#Emph}my {#Prev}sake, then for {#Emph}yours! {#Prev}These grounds ought to be as you always liked. But we shall tolerate my father's taste a while longer, if we must.... Apologies, Melinoë! {#Emph}Erm{#Prev}, here.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: {#Emph}Ah{#Prev}, we've been so busy, lately, Daughter, that we've hardly had much time to see you here...!

2.Text: That's all right, Mother, no need for the both of you to go out of your way. It can be just a quick hello from time to time.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: That may be a while as we get our business sorted out. But let's please stay in touch as time permits.

1.Text: At last you return, Daughter. I was once accustomed to your absence, but more recently less so.

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: What your father means is, now that we see you more often, it's never enough. Though don't come visiting on our account! We know you're being pulled in a lot of different directions lately.

3.Text: Well it's really only the two, but yes. These past nights I've been traveling toward Olympus more. Have you been able to stay in touch with the others throughout all this?

4.Text: We are in contact with Olympus, yes. They have their own matters to resolve as we have ours, but... we have agreed to redouble our efforts to maintain clearer communication channels from now on.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: You've kept so busy, and even still things are bound to be a mess like this for I don't know how long. More than a mortal lifetime, I should think... several, perhaps.

2.Text: Restoring the entire Underworld to working order and undoing all the damage Chronos caused doesn't seem like a quick process. But I like easing it along.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: And have we mentioned we appreciate the help? Go on, Hades, give her your best.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Such a strange route you're taking through the Underworld. By now you've likely spent more time in Oceanus or the Mourning Fields than I have...

2.Text: The direct path down to Tartarus was unavailable so now we're sticking to the one that works. I've gotten rather used to it, and the various unpleasantness along the way.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: We'll have to keep an eye on some of those places, won't we, Hades? Never a dull moment around here.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Our daughter, part of the Unseen... officially, Hades and I aren't even supposed to {#Emph}know {#Prev}of you... where you reside... nothing.

2.Text: The protection of the Underworld is a responsibility we all share... but in retrospect, Nyx, in her wisdom, took certain additional precautions, yes.

3.Text: I don't know how well-kept of a secret the Unseen are at this point. We had to emerge from the shadows once or twice in all this.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: Nyx herself would be the first to say it's useful for the Underworld to instill in others a certain kind of fear. But I feel so fortunate we know you not just from whispered tales of vengeance, but for who you are, Melinoë.

1.Text: Did your mother and I hear correctly that you and your brother clashed? In the midst of Elysium for all to see...?

2.Text: No, Father, it's not what you think! It was what you could call an exhibition match; a friendly challenge, nothing more. Though Zagreus did not go easy on me.

3.Text: A shrewd decision on the boy's part, then, or more likely it was yours. For all the troubles in the Underworld, this type of {#Emph}exhibition match{#Prev}, as you refer to it, may be exactly what the Shades require.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: {#Emph}A morale boost! {#Prev}I suppose they do enjoy this type of violent entertainment over there. Well, as long as Melinoë and Zagreus are open to it...

5.Text: You trained with the Witch of the Crossroads, he trained with the greatest warrior that ever fought in mortal wars. Who is superior shall perhaps be subject to debate.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: You fought with your brother again? In another life, I was surprised how well the two of you got on when you were growing up. Perhaps since he was older...

2.Text: We did get into quite a bit of trouble, as I recall. But I couldn't have asked for a better big brother. He looked out for me, played with me... and now I get to beat up on him!

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: Well, no need to go easy on him. Just as long as it's only for show! I'd say we've had our fill of real in-fighting in our family for the foreseeable future.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Oh, you're hurt... Melinoë, whoever did this to you, once Tartarus is fully restored, we may have to reserve a special spot for them.

2.Text: It's all right, Mother... all part of the process recently. These superficial injuries will all be gone by tomorrow night. Perhaps sooner if I'm fortunate.

3.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
3.Text: All part of the process, then... retracing your steps just like you did to liberate us in the first place. It's all so strange...

1.Text: We heard of the return of the Three Fates. How much you had to do with it shall be for you to know, but tell us... were they in good spirits, at the least?

2.Text: They seemed to be. Clotho, who spoke the most by far, she seemed in quite a cheery mood, now that you mention it! So much so that I have trouble imagining her otherwise...

3.Text: Then we are fortunate, perhaps... for they can be a temperamental bunch. Their moods may not solely dictate the nature of their weavings, but certainly must correlate.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: We were told that they would cease their weavings for a while. You don't believe it, do you, though, Hades...?

5.Text: No, absolutely not. Although I welcome each of you to draw whichever conclusions you see fit.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Melinoë, what do you make of this new age the Fates foretold? You know you have some mortal blood in you... perhaps it's for the best.

2.Text: We did all right with the Fates seemingly leaving everything to us... so if that's the way of things moving forward, I'm open to it. Though, what happens to the Underworld, if the gods are to hold less sway?

3.Text: We shall adapt, as we have always done. But unless this {#Emph}new age {#Prev}causes mortals to be relieved of their defining trait — that they all perish, soon enough — then I should think what we do here shall always serve a vital purpose.

1.Text: Do you two ever... do you have opportunity to speak with the Witch of the Crossroads... with Hecate, now and again?

2.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
2.Text: Given her charge, we're not really supposed to be seen sipping Ambrosia together at this point, though the same is true of you. We do hear about her but respect her privacy.

3.Text: Oh I see, well... anyhow, I think... that it would mean a lot to her to hear from you every so often, if you don't mind? She fought so hard for your return... harder than anyone.

4.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
4.Text: {#Emph}Hahah{#Prev}, well. I think we can find a way to get the occasional message through the veil, right, Hades? Hecate shall always have our gratitude. She saved our little daughter, after all.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Perhaps we're growing strong as a family through all this. Wouldn't that be nice?

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: One of these days or nights we'll have to tidy up this particular chamber, Hades...

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Go show that possibility of Chronos whose side of the family is really in charge here.
If there is something more that we can do to facilitate your efforts, merely ask.
We trust that the Witch of the Crossroads and the rest are lately doing well?
Matters in the House are well in hand. We trust that all is likewise well with you.
We shall always be grateful for what you've done, Daughter.
Your mother and I expected your arrival, and wish to give you our regards.
Much is to be done throughout the House, but we occasionally need to step away.
It is a welcome break from our conventional routine to visit with you here.
We commend not merely your efforts, Daughter, but the consistency of your results.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Your brother wanted me to say {#Emph}hey there {#Prev}for him when next I saw you.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: The House is coming along well enough, though I am glad to get away.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: I know you're all grown up already but you'll always be my baby girl.

1.Speaker: NPC_Persephone_01
1.Text: Hades, I don't know if these are blessings so much as curses against your father...
In shadow, I serve!

2.Text: So glad to see you.

3.Text: Be well, Lord Father.

4.Text: Hail, Lord Father!

5.Text: Be well, Mother!

1.Text: You too, my baby girl.

2.Text: Only because of you.

3.Text: Oh, Daughter...

4.Text: You take care too.

5.Text: {#Emph}<Sigh>

1.Text: Greetings.

2.Text: Greetings.

3.Text: Hail, Daughter.

4.Text: Darkness suits me best.

5.Text: Go unseen.

1.Text: {#Emph}Hrm.

2.Text: Oh, Daughter...

3.Text: Greetings...

4.Text: We tried that once.

5.Text: Death...

1.Text: I have no mood for this.

2.Text: How like your brother.

3.Text: Cease this.

4.Text: Daughter?

5.Text: Oh, blood and darkness...

1.Text: Lash out, if you must.

2.Text: You need not fail as I.

3.Text: Leave me be.

4.Text: Leave me, I said.

5.Text: Oh, blood and darkness...

1.Text: I don't plan to...
We've every chance in the world...
They... fight pretty well.
Not always, no...
For fashion's sake? {#Emph}Hah{#Prev}, no...
My beautiful daughter... we were just talking about you! How you were as a child, both in this life and the other. Growing up is so difficult... and you had to do it twice.

2.Text: Which makes me beyond fortunate. Hecate was the best caretaker I can imagine. And I'm so grateful to have experienced a life with you, Mother... where there was so much warmth. And now you've met this other side of me.

3.Text: And I shall eagerly await getting to know this other side of you even better. And, Hecate...? You're certain it's no burden to you... to continue looking after her, just in case?

4.Text: I swore to you that no harm shall come to your daughter, O Queen, and that vow remains. And I shall always care for her, whether she resides with me or not.

5.Text: Then it's settled...! And, Melinoë... for what it's worth... I likewise opted not to live at home when I was in my youth!

6.Text: Please reconsider this, Melinoë... you cannot be serious about returning to that dusty glade. Your rightful home is here, and you may be unable to return whilst you are with us due to laws much older than ours. To serve the Unseen...

7.Text: ...is to serve in shadow. I know full well, Headmistress, and do not make this decision lightly, but... I can't leave the Crossroads. Especially when we've so much left to do.

8.Text: Working with Chronos on this new venture of his... you've been instrumental in altering Time as we know it, so you're certainly the best fit to keep things that way.

9.Text: Ensuring Time keeps working in our favor seems like a good way to spend my own time! It should be interesting, and the matter is close to my heart. Perhaps I was born for this.

10.Text: You were born for much more. But we'll do our share. Cerberus has already taken to prancing through the Fields of his own accord, and your father and I shall not be far. As for your brother, well... he always turns up!

11.Text: All this is going to be an adjustment, though, isn't it? Even if I'll see you all again soon.

12.Text: {#Emph}Ah, hahaha! {#Prev}An adjustment is putting it mildly. Now go make your rounds, and I'll see you off before you depart. I love you, baby girl.

1.Text: I love you too, Mother.
Be well, Mother!

2.Text: Thank you for being here.

3.Text: Take care, Mother.

1.Text: You too, my baby girl.

2.Text: Only because of you.

3.Text: Oh, Daughter...

4.Text: You take care too.

5.Text: {#Emph}<Sigh>

1.Text: Easy there.

2.Text: Were you always this feisty?

3.Text: How like your brother.

4.Text: Come now.
